h: 2Baba's estranged wife Natasha Osawaru reveals son's face on his first birthday
p: Edo lawmaker Natasha Osawaru has shared photos of her son Gabriel as he turns one, keeping her promise to show his face. She described him as a blessing.
body: Edo State lawmaker Natasha Osawaru, the estranged wife of singer Innocent Idibia (2Baba), has shared photos of her son, Gabriel, as he celebrates his first birthday.
Natasha posted several pictures of the boy on social media on Saturday, 21 November 2026. She had previously promised to show her son's face when he turned one.
Alongside the photos, she described Gabriel as a blessing who has brought her great happiness, thanked God for him, and said she had so much to say but was overwhelmed with emotion.
Natasha Osawaru is a member of the Edo State House of Assembly and is described as 2Baba's estranged wife.
more: She had promised to reveal his face at one.
